BrochureContent.Content: Located on the edge of Kilcar Village, is this three storey detached home. Kilcar is known far and wide for its stunning coastal landscapes (most notable being Slieve League Sea Cliffs) and its strong Irish musical traditions with regular music sessions in the local pubs. Built in 2005, the house has a sitting room and kitchen/dining room plus bathroom on the ground floor, three bedrooms (one en-suite) plus bathroom on the first floor and three more bedrooms, utility room and integral garage all at basement level. A great family home or this property could be divided and a basement apartment created, making it an investment property or a combination of a family home with a rental portion. All enquiries welcome.
